name: Park-Aid Asphalt and Maintenance, Inc.
summary: Park-Aid Asphalt and Maintenance, Inc. manufactures and sells child safety solutions to schools and day care centers in the United States. Its products include the ATWEC Alert, commercial backup system, KV-4 reminder system w/RFID technology, KVX-4 complete system, alert senior ID, ATWEC cam, Live Vue, and mobile and mobile WI-FI. Park-Aid Asphalt and Maintenance, Inc. was formerly known as ATWEC Technologies, Inc. and changed its name to Park-Aid Asphalt and Maintenance, Inc. in June 2026. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee.
